headword: {洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}

definitions.explanation: Detergent specifically formulated for washing clothes, available in liquid, powder, or pod form.

examples.japanese: {洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}が{切|き}れた。
examples.english: We've run out of laundry detergent.

examples.japanese: {液体|えきたい}の{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}のほうが{溶|と}けやすい。
examples.english: Liquid laundry detergent dissolves more easily.

examples.japanese: {肌|はだ}が{弱|よわ}いので{無添加|むてんか}の{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I use additive-free laundry detergent because I have sensitive skin.

notes:
USAGE:
{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい} is the specific term for laundry detergent, as opposed to {洗剤|せんざい} which refers to detergent/cleanser in general (including dish soap, surface cleaner, etc.).

TYPES:
- {液体|えきたい}{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい} (liquid detergent)
- {粉末|ふんまつ}{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい} (powdered detergent)
- {柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}{入|い}り{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい} (detergent with fabric softener)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}を{入|い}れる (to add laundry detergent)
- {洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}の{量|りょう} (the amount of detergent)
